message: Workouts can now be imported from a Strong or Hevy CSV export, and your own workouts can be exported as a CSV. Both are in the menu at the top right of Workouts. Before an import writes anything, you see how many workouts and sets the file holds and choose what to do with each exercise name the app couldn't match: pick one from the library, create it, or skip it. Importing the same file again adds nothing.
